title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
What the live paper record shows is the engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. Every position here is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Live starts and first signals

Live starts: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. Those start dates are part of the record, so the trend engines do not share the same live window. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The recorded exit rule was a close below the 10-day low. That exit occurred at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The measurement is the result of applying the stated entry and exit rules to recorded prices. It is a completed paper outcome, not a forecast and not an assessment of the strategy.

A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. An open position has no final percentage in the record, because the exit rule has not triggered. In testing, losing trades were common and the average winner was roughly +19%. A single losing closed trade at the start is therefore consistent with the tested pattern rather than an exception to it. That comparison describes historical test behavior; it is not a promise about future results.

## Current open positions

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so the record contains an open paper position alongside those engine counts. The open position is reported as an entry price and date; it has not been assigned a final result.

Zero open positions for an engine means the record shows no active paper trade for that engine at the snapshot time. It is a state reading. It does not mean the engine is disabled, and it does not mean a future entry cannot occur. Likewise, an open position is simply a position that has not yet met its exit rule in the record.

## Closed trades and averages

htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade. The record reports the average as null, so no numeric average is available for those 4 trades. trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 6, average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 7, average -13.34% net per trade.

The ATOM trade is one of the closed outcomes: entry at 2.066, exit at 1.703, result −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. An average across several trades can differ from any single trade, and a small number of trades gives a noisy average. The record reports the average; it does not explain the variance. All of these are paper results. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

## Market filter and breakout distance

trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off. trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off. The filter status is part of the engines' own state. With it off, both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper at the snapshot. The record does not state a future on or off change.

The closest names to a 20-day breakout are ZECUSDT at 8.28% below its high, TRXUSDT at 9.36% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 9.82% below its high, for both trend engines. These percentages measure distance to a breakout level. A name 8.28% below its high is closer to that level than a name 9.82% below its high, but both are below it. The record lists the closest names; it does not list the full universe. These distances are measurements, not signals to act.

The market filter being off and the breakout distances being positive are separate readings in the same snapshot. One describes the filter state; the other describes how far selected names are from a breakout level. Neither reading is a recommendation.

## Where and when to check

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-09T02:48:44.170Z. The record updates continuously, so a later reading can show different open positions, closed-trade counts, averages, and filter states. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. No number in this note is a prediction. The record is a log of paper states and measured outcomes under stated rules.
